description: This file defines the KeyHandler class responsible for creating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for generating keys, checking their existence, and retrieving the key path, with proper exception handling.

classes.name: KeyHandler
classes.description: A utility class in the OrangeHRM system for managing cryptographic keys, including creation, validation, and retrieval functions.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, saves it to a file, and throws an exception if a key already exists or if creation fails.

methods.name: readKey
methods.description: Reads the cryptographic key from the storage file, with error handling for missing or unreadable files.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks whether the key file exists at the expected location.

methods.name: getRealPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the key file if it exists, or null otherwise.

methods.name: getPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the configured file path for storing the key, combining a configured directory with a filename.
